probe.text_sample: Melody Digital Melody Digital [ 49 ] Projects showcased on this platform represent collaborative efforts with brands, studios, or creative teams. Founded in 2019, Melody is the interdisciplinary portfolio of brothers Matija and Roko Gabrilo. Operating independently or in tandem from Los Angeles, New York, and Vancouver, our clients and commissions span cultural and commercial sectors. We create with intention. Not to imagine what could be, but to eliminate what shouldn't be. This methodology produces refined, nuanced, yet distinct work across various mediums and industries.
